info.title: Cabin Visits API
info.description: REST API for cabin visit statistics: occupancy, driving, guests and EV metrics.

get.description: Returns the guest's avatar as a JPEG image. The response has an ETag and Cache-Control header, and a conditional request with If-None-Match returns 304. Use the avatarUrl from the live stats response, which changes when the image does.

parameters.name: guestId
parameters.description: Internal unique identifier of the guest.

400.description: The guestId path parameter is missing.

404.description: The guest does not exist or has no avatar.

304.description: The avatar has not changed since the ETag in If-None-Match.

get.description: Returns whether the cabin is currently occupied, details about the ongoing and next reservation (dates, guest statistics, remaining/upcoming nights), and all-time totals (visits, nights, unique guests) excluding future bookings. Suitable for a smart mirror or real-time dashboard.
Returns a quick summary for the current calendar year: number of visits, total nights, and total driving distance to/from the cabin. Suitable for a summary card or widget.
Returns a sorted list of years for which reservations exist. Use this to populate a year picker in a dashboard.

Returns full statistics for a given year, including visit counts, nights, occupancy percentages (days/weeks/months), guest overview, EV statistics (distance, energy consumption, regeneration), driving time stats (avg/min/max to and from cabin), typical departure and arrival times, and a monthly breakdown for all 12 months.

A guest is counted as **new** in a given year if that year is the first year in which they appear in any reservation.

200.description: Full statistics for the requested year.

get.description: Returns statistics for a specific month: visit count with comparisons against the previous 30 days, the same month last year, and the year-to-date monthly average; nights min/avg/max; occupancy percentages; guest list; and driving time and moment stats including diff vs. the previous month.

400.description: Invalid year or month parameter (month must be 1–12).

get.description: Returns guest statistics across all years: top 10 guests by number of visits and by total nights, gender distribution, and age group breakdown (0–12, 13–17, 18–30, 31–50, 51+). Suitable for a hall-of-fame view or demographic overview.

GuestPeriodStats.title: GuestPeriodStats
GuestPeriodStats.description: Guest statistics for one period (the current year or all years), counting only started reservations up to today.

totalVisits.description: Number of reservations the guest was part of that started in the period (arrival date).

totalDays.description: Number of days the guest was present at the cabin in the period, up to and including today.

visitsRank.description: Guest's rank by total visits among all guests in the period (1 = most). Tied guests share rank. Null if no visits.

daysRank.description: Guest's rank by total days among all guests in the period (1 = most). Tied guests share rank. Null if no visits.

guestId.description: Internal unique identifier of the guest.

age.description: Guest's age in the current year (current year - birthYear).

isFamily.description: True if the guest is a family member (owner of the cabin), false for other guests.

avatarUrl.description: Relative URL to the guest's avatar image (JPEG), see GET /api/guests/{guestId}/avatar. Null if the guest has no avatar.

isFirstVisit.description: True if the guest has no reservations that started before this reservation.

firstVisitDate.description: Start date of the guest's first started reservation. Null if the guest has no started reservations.

lastVisitDate.description: End date of the guest's last completed visit before this reservation. Null if there is no completed visit.

yearsVisited.description: Years in which the guest has started reservations, in descending order.

CurrentReservationInfo.title: CurrentReservationInfo
CurrentReservationInfo.description: Details about the ongoing reservation. Null if the cabin is not currently occupied.

startDate.description: First day of the current reservation (check-in date, inclusive).

endDate.description: Last day of the current reservation (check-out date, exclusive — cabin is free from this date).

guests.description: Statistics for each guest in the current reservation, ordered by current year days rank.

remainingNights.description: Number of nights remaining in the current reservation, from today until check-out.

NextReservationInfo.title: NextReservationInfo
NextReservationInfo.description: Details about the next upcoming reservation. Null if no future reservation exists.

startDate.description: First day of the next reservation (check-in date, inclusive).

endDate.description: Last day of the next reservation (check-out date, exclusive).

guests.description: Statistics for each guest in the next reservation, ordered by current year days rank.

daysUntil.description: Number of days from today until the next reservation starts.

guestId.description: Guest the fact is about. Null for facts about the whole group or the cabin.

priority.description: Importance from 0 to 100, higher is more important. Lists are sorted by priority, descending.

isOccupied.description: True if the cabin is currently occupied (a reservation has started but not yet ended).

allTimeVisits.description: Total number of reservations that have started, across all years. Future bookings are excluded.

allTimeNights.description: Total number of nights across all reservations that have started. Future bookings are excluded.

allTimeUniqueGuests.description: Total number of unique guests registered in the system.

guestFunFacts.description: Fun facts about the guests of the current reservation, sorted by priority. Empty if the cabin is not occupied.

cabinFunFacts.description: Fun facts about the cabin as a whole, sorted by priority.

nextVisitFunFacts.description: Fun facts about the next upcoming reservation, sorted by priority. Empty if no future reservation exists.

year.description: The calendar year this summary covers.

visits.description: Number of reservations that started in this calendar year.

totalNights.description: Total nights spent at the cabin during this calendar year, counting only nights within the year boundary.

totalDistanceKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips to and from the cabin this year. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

MonthlyVisitCount.title: MonthlyVisitCount
MonthlyVisitCount.description: Number of reservation starts in a given month.

visitCount.description: Number of reservation starts in this month.

YearVisitsStats.title: YearVisitsStats
YearVisitsStats.description: Visit count for this year with comparisons against the previous year.

totalVisits.description: Number of reservations that started in this calendar year.

comparedToPreviousYear.description: Difference between this year's visit count and the previous year's visit count. Positive means more visits than last year.

avgMonthlyVisits.description: Average number of visits per calendar month (totalVisits / 12).

avgGroupSize.description: Average number of guests per reservation this year. Null if there are no reservations.

MonthlyDaysCount.title: MonthlyDaysCount
MonthlyDaysCount.description: The month in which the single longest individual stay (by days) started this year. Null if no reservations exist.

daysCount.description: Duration in days of the longest individual stay that started in this month.

YearDaysStats.title: YearDaysStats
YearDaysStats.description: Occupied-day statistics for this year (including departure day).

totalDays.description: Total number of occupied days in this year across all reservations, counting overlapping reservations only once per day. Departure day is counted as an occupied day.

minDays.description: Shortest stay in days (full duration, arrival and departure day included) among reservations that started in this year. Null if no reservations exist.

maxDays.description: Longest stay in days (full duration, arrival and departure day included) among reservations that started in this year. Null if no reservations exist.

avgDays.description: Average stay in days (full duration, arrival and departure day included) among reservations that started in this year. Null if no reservations exist.

comparedToPreviousYear.description: Difference between totalDays for this year and totalDays for the previous year. Positive means more occupied days than last year.

YearNightsStats.title: YearNightsStats
YearNightsStats.description: Occupied-night statistics for this year (excluding departure day).

totalNights.description: Total number of occupied nights in this year across all reservations, counting overlapping reservations only once per night. Departure night is not counted.

minNights.description: Shortest stay in nights (full duration) among reservations that started in this year. Null if no reservations exist.

maxNights.description: Longest stay in nights (full duration) among reservations that started in this year. Null if no reservations exist.

avgNights.description: Average stay in nights (full duration) among reservations that started in this year. Null if no reservations exist.

avgMonthlyNights.description: Average number of occupied nights per calendar month (totalNights / 12).

comparedToPreviousYear.description: Difference between totalNights for this year and totalNights for the previous year. Positive means more occupied nights than last year.

OccupancyStats.title: OccupancyStats
OccupancyStats.description: Occupancy percentages for a period (year or month) across days, weeks and, for years, months.

dayOccupancy.description: Percentage of calendar days in the period where the cabin was occupied, including the departure day. E.g. 25.0 means 25%.

weekOccupancy.description: Percentage of ISO weeks in the period that contained at least one occupied day. E.g. 50.0 means half of all weeks had at least one visit.

monthOccupancy.description: Percentage of the 12 calendar months in the year that contained at least one occupied day. Only present in yearly statistics, null in monthly context.

TopGuestByDays.title: TopGuestByDays
TopGuestByDays.description: The guest with the most total days at the cabin in the year.

guestId.description: Internal unique identifier of the guest.

age.description: Guest's age in the reference year (ageYear - birthYear).

totalVisits.description: Number of reservations the guest was part of that started in the year (arrival date).

totalDays.description: Total number of days the guest was present at the cabin in the year.

GuestVisitStats.title: GuestVisitStats
GuestVisitStats.description: A guest's visits and days at the cabin within a period (year or month).

guestId.description: Internal unique identifier of the guest.

age.description: Guest's age in the reference year (ageYear - birthYear).

totalVisits.description: Number of reservations the guest was part of that started in the period (arrival date).

totalDays.description: Total number of days the guest was present at the cabin in the period, counting only days that fall within the period boundary.

YearDrivingDistanceStats.title: YearDrivingDistanceStats
YearDrivingDistanceStats.description: Driving distance statistics for trips to, from, and at the cabin this year. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

totalToCabinKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips to the cabin this year.

minToCabinKm.description: Shortest single trip distance to the cabin in km this year. Null if no trips exist.

maxToCabinKm.description: Longest single trip distance to the cabin in km this year. Null if no trips exist.

avgToCabinKm.description: Average trip distance to the cabin in km this year. Null if no trips exist.

totalFromCabinKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips from the cabin this year.

minFromCabinKm.description: Shortest single trip distance from the cabin in km this year. Null if no trips exist.

maxFromCabinKm.description: Longest single trip distance from the cabin in km this year. Null if no trips exist.

avgFromCabinKm.description: Average trip distance from the cabin in km this year. Null if no trips exist.

totalAtCabinKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips at (around) the cabin this year.

minAvgSpeedToCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all toCabin legs, for the fastest reservation trip to the cabin this year. Null if no trips exist.

maxAvgSpeedToCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all toCabin legs, for the slowest reservation trip to the cabin this year. Null if no trips exist.

avgAvgSpeedToCabinKmh.description: Mean of avgSpeedKmh across all reservations with a toCabin trip this year. Null if no trips exist.

minAvgSpeedFromCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all fromCabin legs, for the fastest reservation trip from the cabin this year. Null if no trips exist.

maxAvgSpeedFromCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all fromCabin legs, for the slowest reservation trip from the cabin this year. Null if no trips exist.

avgAvgSpeedFromCabinKmh.description: Mean of avgSpeedKmh across all reservations with a fromCabin trip this year. Null if no trips exist.

YearEvStats.title: YearEvStats
YearEvStats.description: Electric vehicle energy statistics for trips to and from the cabin this year. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

totalEnergyConsumedKwh.description: Total energy consumed (kWh) for all trips to and from the cabin this year, derived from average consumption × distance per trip. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

avgEnergyConsumptionKwhPer100km.description: Distance-weighted average energy consumption in kWh per 100 km across all trips to and from the cabin this year. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

totalEnergyRegeneratedKwh.description: Total energy regenerated (kWh) through regenerative braking across all trips to and from the cabin this year. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

YearDrivingTimeStats.title: YearDrivingTimeStats
YearDrivingTimeStats.description: Driving duration statistics (avg/min/max) for trips to and from the cabin this year. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

year.description: The calendar year these driving time statistics cover.

avgToCabinMinutes.description: Average total driving duration to the cabin in minutes, summing all legs per trip (including stops). Null if no trip data exists.

avgToCabin.description: Average driving duration to the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

minToCabinMinutes.description: Shortest total driving duration to the cabin in minutes across all trips this year. Null if no trip data exists.

minToCabin.description: Shortest driving duration to the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

maxToCabinMinutes.description: Longest total driving duration to the cabin in minutes across all trips this year. Null if no trip data exists.

maxToCabin.description: Longest driving duration to the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

avgFromCabinMinutes.description: Average total driving duration from the cabin in minutes, summing all legs per trip (including stops). Null if no trip data exists.

avgFromCabin.description: Average driving duration from the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

minFromCabinMinutes.description: Shortest total driving duration from the cabin in minutes across all trips this year. Null if no trip data exists.

minFromCabin.description: Shortest driving duration from the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

maxFromCabinMinutes.description: Longest total driving duration from the cabin in minutes across all trips this year. Null if no trip data exists.

maxFromCabin.description: Longest driving duration from the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

YearDrivingMomentStats.title: YearDrivingMomentStats
YearDrivingMomentStats.description: Average departure and arrival clock times for trips to and from the cabin this year, expressed in Oslo timezone. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

year.description: The calendar year these driving moment statistics cover.

avgDepartureHomeMinutes.description: Average departure time from home (Oslo timezone) across all toCabin trips this year, expressed as minutes since midnight. E.g. 540 = 09:00.

avgDepartureHome.description: Average departure time from home formatted as HH:mm (Oslo timezone). Null if no trip data exists.

avgArrivalCabinMinutes.description: Average arrival time at the cabin (Oslo timezone) across all toCabin trips this year, expressed as minutes since midnight.

avgArrivalCabin.description: Average arrival time at the cabin formatted as HH:mm (Oslo timezone). Null if no trip data exists.

avgDepartureCabinMinutes.description: Average departure time from the cabin (Oslo timezone) across all fromCabin trips this year, expressed as minutes since midnight.

avgDepartureCabin.description: Average departure time from the cabin formatted as HH:mm (Oslo timezone). Null if no trip data exists.

avgArrivalHomeMinutes.description: Average arrival time back home (Oslo timezone) across all fromCabin trips this year, expressed as minutes since midnight.

avgArrivalHome.description: Average arrival time back home formatted as HH:mm (Oslo timezone). Null if no trip data exists.

MonthVisitsStats.title: MonthVisitsStats
MonthVisitsStats.description: Visit count for this month with comparisons against other reference periods.

totalVisits.description: Number of reservations that started in this month.

comparedToPreviousMonth.description: Difference between this month's visit count and the previous calendar month's visit count. Positive means more visits than last month.

comparedToSameMonthLastYear.description: Difference between this month's visit count and the same month in the previous year. Positive means more visits than the same month last year.

comparedToYearToDateAverage.description: Difference between this month's visit count and the year-to-date monthly average (sum of visits Jan–this month divided by number of months so far). Positive means above average.

MonthDaysStats.title: MonthDaysStats
MonthDaysStats.description: Occupied-day statistics for this month (including departure day).

totalDays.description: Total number of occupied days in this month across all reservations, counting overlapping reservations only once per day. Departure day is counted as an occupied day.

minDays.description: Shortest stay in days (full duration, arrival and departure day included) among reservations that started in this month. Null if no reservations started this month.

maxDays.description: Longest stay in days (full duration, arrival and departure day included) among reservations that started in this month. Null if no reservations started this month.

avgDays.description: Average stay in days (full duration, arrival and departure day included) among reservations that started in this month. Null if no reservations started this month.

comparedToPreviousMonth.description: Difference between totalDays for this month and totalDays for the previous calendar month. Positive means more occupied days than last month.

comparedToSameMonthLastYear.description: Difference between totalDays for this month and totalDays for the same month in the previous year. Positive means more occupied days than the same month last year.

MonthNightsStats.title: MonthNightsStats
MonthNightsStats.description: Occupied-night statistics for this month (excluding departure day).

totalNights.description: Total number of occupied nights in this month across all reservations, counting overlapping reservations only once per night. Departure night is not counted.

minNights.description: Shortest stay in nights (full duration) among reservations that started in this month. Null if no reservations started this month.

maxNights.description: Longest stay in nights (full duration) among reservations that started in this month. Null if no reservations started this month.

avgNights.description: Average stay in nights (full duration) among reservations that started in this month. Null if no reservations started this month.

comparedToPreviousMonth.description: Difference between totalNights for this month and totalNights for the previous calendar month. Positive means more occupied nights than last month.

comparedToSameMonthLastYear.description: Difference between totalNights for this month and totalNights for the same month in the previous year. Positive means more occupied nights than the same month last year.

MonthDrivingDistanceStats.description: Driving distance statistics for trips to, from, and at the cabin in this month. Null if no vehicle trip data exists.

totalToCabinKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips to the cabin in this month.

minToCabinKm.description: Shortest single trip distance to the cabin in km this month. Null if no trips exist.

maxToCabinKm.description: Longest single trip distance to the cabin in km this month. Null if no trips exist.

avgToCabinKm.description: Average trip distance to the cabin in km this month. Null if no trips exist.

totalFromCabinKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips from the cabin in this month.

minFromCabinKm.description: Shortest single trip distance from the cabin in km this month. Null if no trips exist.

maxFromCabinKm.description: Longest single trip distance from the cabin in km this month. Null if no trips exist.

avgFromCabinKm.description: Average trip distance from the cabin in km this month. Null if no trips exist.

totalAtCabinKm.description: Total driving distance in kilometres for all trips at (around) the cabin in this month.

minAvgSpeedToCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all toCabin legs, for the fastest reservation trip to the cabin this month. Null if no trips exist.

maxAvgSpeedToCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all toCabin legs, for the slowest reservation trip to the cabin this month. Null if no trips exist.

avgAvgSpeedToCabinKmh.description: Mean of avgSpeedKmh across all reservations with a toCabin trip this month. Null if no trips exist.

minAvgSpeedFromCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all fromCabin legs, for the fastest reservation trip from the cabin this month. Null if no trips exist.

maxAvgSpeedFromCabinKmh.description: Average of VehicleTrip.averageSpeed across all fromCabin legs, for the slowest reservation trip from the cabin this month. Null if no trips exist.

avgAvgSpeedFromCabinKmh.description: Mean of avgSpeedKmh across all reservations with a fromCabin trip this month. Null if no trips exist.

avgFromCabin.description: Average driving duration from the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

minFromCabinMinutes.description: Shortest total driving duration from the cabin in minutes across all trips this month. Null if no trip data exists.

minFromCabin.description: Shortest driving duration from the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

maxFromCabinMinutes.description: Longest total driving duration from the cabin in minutes across all trips this month. Null if no trip data exists.

maxFromCabin.description: Longest driving duration from the cabin formatted as HH:mm. Null if no trip data exists.

GenderDistribution.description: Gender distribution across all registered guests.

maleCount.description: Number of male guests among all registered guests.

femaleCount.description: Number of female guests among all registered guests.

femalePercent.description: Percentage of female guests (femaleCount / total * 100), rounded to one decimal.

guestCount.description: Number of registered guests whose current age falls within this range.

topGuestsByVisits.description: Top 10 guests ranked by total number of reservation visits across all years.

topGuestsByDays.description: Top 10 guests ranked by total number of days spent at the cabin across all years.

ageGroups.description: Age group breakdown of all registered guests, using current age at time of the request.
